newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements on Tuesday, the New York Fed confirmed.
The operation was unexpected, as analysts predicted the Fed would stay out of the open market. They had argued that last week's aggressive moves by the Fed took care of this week's add need.
The Fed passed on intervention on Monday.
Federal funds were trading at the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target rate at the time of the action.
